questions.stem: Why do isotopes of the same element have identical chemical properties?

options.text: Because they have the same number of neutrons
Because they have the same mass number
Because they have the same number of electrons and the same electron configuration
Because they are found in the same part of the Periodic Table

questions.explanation: Chemical properties depend on electron arrangement. Since isotopes have the same number of protons, they also have the same number of electrons and the same electron configuration, so they react in the same way.
